record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Does the well-filtered reflection functor preserve arbitrary products of T0 spaces; equivalently, for every family {X_i}, is the Topw-reflection (prod_i X_i)^w homeomorphic to prod_i X_i^w, where Topw is the category of well-filtered spaces?

evidence.quote: Question 7.17. ([51]) Does the well-filtered reflection functor preserves arbitrary products of T0 spaces?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions. A topological space $X$ is called $T_0$ if for any two distinct points there is an open set containing exactly one of them. For a $T_0$ space $X$, write $\mathcal{O}(X)$ for its topology and let $\mathrm{Irr}_c(X)$ denote the set of irreducible closed subsets. A subset $K\subseteq X$ is called compact saturated if it is compact and equal to the intersection of all open sets containing it. A $T_0$ space $X$ is called well-filtered (WF) if, for every filtered family $\{K_i\}_{i\in I}$ of compact saturated subsets of $X$ and every open set $U$ with $\bigcap_{i\in I} K_i \subseteq U$, there exists $i_0\in I$ with $K_{i_0}\subseteq U$.
 
Let $\mathbf{Top}_0$ denote the category of $T_0$ spaces with continuous maps, and let $\mathbf{Top}_w$ denote its full subcategory consisting of well-filtered spaces. The subcategory $\mathbf{Top}_w$ is reflective in $\mathbf{Top}_0$: for each $T_0$ space $X$ there exist a well-filtered space $X^w$ and a continuous map $\eta_X\colon X\to X^w$ such that every continuous map from $X$ to a well-filtered space factors uniquely through $\eta_X$. The assignment $X\mapsto X^w$ extends to a functor (the well-filtered reflection functor) from $\mathbf{Top}_0$ to $\mathbf{Top}_w$, left adjoint to the inclusion.
 
Question. Does the well-filtered reflection functor preserve arbitrary products? Equivalently, for every family $\{X_i\}_{i\in I}$ of $T_0$ spaces, is the canonical continuous map
$$\Big(\prod_{i\in I} X_i\Big)^{w} \longrightarrow \prod_{i\in I} X_i^{w}$$
induced by the universal property a homeomorphism?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the literature on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces. A targeted web search did not surface a published resolution; related works on well-filtered reflections (e.g., constructions via WD-sets) discuss the reflection but do not appear to settle preservation of arbitrary products. Hence the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On T0 spaces determined by well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of well-filtered reflections of T0 spaces and study of their properties.
status_evidence.claim: The well-filtered reflection of T0 spaces is studied, but preservation of arbitrary products is not established as a general result.

status_evidence.title: On T0 spaces determined by well-filtered spaces - ScienceDirect
status_evidence.snippet: Major properties of well-filtered reflections of T0 spaces investigated.
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference on well-filtered reflections does not give a positive answer to product preservation.
